_comment: D25 + the Tailscale front door — the auth block to MERGE into the coordinator config once `tailscale serve` is proxying :8899. Apply it with the POST /config call in README.md. Until then GENGHIS stays in LOCAL mode (direct-LAN = admin), unchanged. Do NOT set proxy_secret before `serve` is live, or you will drop your own local access to viewer. `tailscale serve` injects Tailscale-User-Login (the signed-in tailnet user); it sends no groups, so map people by address. NOTE: `tailscale funnel` (public) injects NO identity — use the Cloudflare option for a public front door.
